title: StegDJ streaming development and affective transition orchestration
originating_goal: Use StegDJ with StegMusic to develop sympathetic recognition and subtle affective-response understanding using traditional streaming observations and consented multimodal sensors, with StegVerse primary and third parties fallback-only.
release_reason: All session-specific StegDJ source requirements are implemented and durable. Remaining validation observation, Site consumption, and optional authenticated platform routes have named durable owners and require no chat-held information.

machine_owned_continuation.release_condition: An exact-SHA workflow run completes successfully using anonymous public fetch, permissions {}, no credential environment, schema checks, tests, and credential scan.
The active Site handoff admits a non-conflicting StegDJ/StegMusic integration and live playback/observation evidence is recorded.
A platform/distributor API is explicitly selected and TVC admits a scoped capability; bounded authorized export ingestion remains available without this dependency.
